BiblicalUsage: Hadrach is a land named once, in Zechariah's oracle — the burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof. The oracle names it first, before Damascus, as a place where God's word comes to rest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's word rests even on lands we cannot place, and Hadrach is the proof that no border is outside His burden.
